root_cause: The CI collector filtered run.name === 'Required test', while live pull-request workflows set run-name='Required test PR #N <SHA>'. Thus required runs were excluded and the new evidence guard could incorrectly freeze autonomous tuning. In addition, max three pages (300 runs) were labeled as a seven-day measurement even when the API sample did not span seven days.
failureModes: false-zero required queue and total measurement samples
self-optimizer holds due to absent required evidence despite available runs
observed recent subset labeled as full seven-day history
latest 60 workflows crowd out critical required runs
prevention: recognize exact Required test PR run-name and canonical name, but only pull_request event
reserve up to 12 of 60 sampled jobs' workflow runs for Required runs
publish requested versus actual pagination window evidence and completeness
preserve 300-run API fetch budget, 60 sampled run budget and all existing protected gates

evaluation.baseline_comparison: GitHub PR #4174 run-name format versus exact-equality collector; simulated 75 other run records preceding 16 Required runs.
evaluation.success_metric: required_queue_sample_count > 0 for actual detected protected PRs; truthful observation_seven_day_complete=false when pagination budget exhausted; CI gates unchanged.
evaluation.rollback: Protected revert of candidate on regression; unknown window never assumed complete.
